## Preview your own filament colors in Windows 0.24.35

In Saved Models, choose **3MF · 4 filaments** to see the selected model with its suggested spool colors. Pick each slot's color or enter a six-digit hex code. The rotatable preview redraws as you edit. The percentage beside each slot shows its share of the model triangles. Unused and duplicate spools keep their slot numbers. Workbench remembers custom spools on this PC for other models and future sessions. **Use model colors** restores automatic matching.

## Custom spool and preview validation, Windows 0.24.35

Tested the gallery's native Windows workflow with a saved five-part owl. Compared the actual WebGL draw buffers and material colors for all 147,799 triangles with the resulting 3MF slot assignments. Verified custom slot order, color-picker and hex input, invalid input, duplicate colors, automatic reset, model switching, and offline ElegooSlicer toolpaths using the same four spool colors. Also checked full-color 3MF, STL and GLB exports. No physical printing was performed.
